description: Robyn’s ability to listen to teachers about what they need for students is important to me. Her fight for us to be fairly represented as a new larger liberal group of residents is important to me. And her support of a health care system that will get us through Covid-19 and then support us all after it is over, providing for students, parents, elderly and essential workers who will be nursing hidden mental wounds is important to me. Who Robyn is and what she stands for is important to me. The only path I see forward is one through empathy and kindness and remembering that LOVE WINS.”
